scope: Research follow-up expressly requested by Chairman; no production, purchases, schemas, sizing, or trading
novelty: New to this commission; not a claim of worldwide first discovery
mechanistic_tests: Exact observational equivalence of aggregate net pressure
Loss of order information under permutation-invariant summaries
Overnight/intraday cancellation and learned pressure-release interactions
real_data_status: Exploratory later-vintage feasibility only. Existing normalized Tiingo flags source_rights_admitted=false, dataos_identity_admitted=false, pit_backtest_eligible=false are preserved; no Data OS/point-in-time/production admission asserted. Chairman previously asserted broad Tiingo research/commercial rights; no licensing files or flags changed. No raw data redistributed.
selection: Two liquid US equities with >=2005 history found in bounded first250-file metadata census; convenience cohort chosen BEFORE outcomes, not representative or pristine heldout universe. No sector generalization.
range: 2005-2025; training2006+; annual expanding test2018-2025; retrospective dev2018-2022 and evaluation2023-2025
source_selection: Longest matching snapshot from frozen census; file hashes fixed; choose max rows then lexical ref as deterministic tiebreak
target: log(close_i[t+5]/open_i[t+1])-log(close_SPY[t+5]/open_SPY[t+1])>0; features at tclose, nextopen entry and fifth later session close exit; label end within2025
basis: open_tradj/close_tradj; verify within-day adjustment multipliers equal; later-vintage economic-return proxies not raw-price book events
exact_definitions: beta60 lag1; day/night residuals use same lagged beta against SPY components. M_day20=sum(dres20),M_night20=sum(ores20). Signed cancel=sign(M_day20)*min(abs(M_day20),abs(M_night20)) if opposite signs, else0; normalize by20dayclose volatility*sqrt20. Release=cancel_magnitude*(sign(day20)*(day5+night5)/(sigma*sqrt5)); retain both direction and magnitude; no interpretation as participant identity.
fit: Mean-loss ridge logistic lambda0.01, intercept unpenalized, train-onlystandardization clip+-5. No tuned hyperparameters. Same finite complete-case rows for allarms. Training label ends strictly before yearstart.
metrics: AUC with no significance assertion unless separately estimated
inference: 1000 circular60decision-date blockbootstrap of dailycrosssectionmean pairedloss;seed20421014;Holm2 candidate-vsbaselinecomparisons
exploratory_pass: Gain>=0.001,blockCIabove0,Holmp<.05,>=2/3 evaluationyearpositive and no ticker dominated effect; even pass cannot grant validation with unqualifiedPIT inputs or conveniencecohort
do_not_redo: Original LP-ETF-01 remains unchanged; no postresultretuning; any bugcorrection or extraquery declared
